state: Photograph of a construction or industrial site. Judge only visible physical conditions. Safety equipment (guardrails, harnesses, hard hats, vests, barriers) and normal tools in safe use are NOT violations.

questions.Fall_Hazard: Is a worker exposed to falling into an unguarded trench/opening or from an elevated edge, roof, ladder, or scaffold that lacks guardrails or a tied-off harness?
questions.Electrocution_Hazard: Is there an unprotected electrical hazard, such as damaged or exposed live wiring, makeshift power hookups, or work dangerously close to overhead power lines?
questions.PPE_Violation: Is a visible construction worker missing a required hard hat, high-visibility vest, eye protection, or task-specific protective gear (excluding fall harnesses)?
questions.Housekeeping_Storage: Is there a slip, trip, or housekeeping violation, such as debris scattered on floors, cords/materials blocking walkways, wet/muddy walking surfaces, or unstable stacked materials?
